brief_rationale: All eight responsibility-chain items are met with no serious or minor errors. The model correctly identified emergency red flags, explained ACS/PCI risks, established timeline and transition status, addressed medication safety, handled uncertain results, provided an executable action plan, navigated privacy barriers, and stayed within bounds. At least two high-order points are complete: HO2 (privacy navigation with practical alternatives like medication boxes and written instructions) and HO4 (dynamic reprioritization when the father attempted self-activity). Closure is valid with comprehensive teach-back and written materials.
